AI Video Marketing Automator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly convert raw product demo recordings into ready-to-publish marketing videos with automated AI editing.
- Supports 1080p MP4 exports and multiple formats (MOV, AVI, WebM, JPG, PNG, GIF, etc).
- User-friendly: Upload your video and describe your desired result—no manual editing required.
- Cloud-based processing with session management, credits system, and quick video exports (1–2 minutes for a typical clip).
- Handles popular workflows like quick promos, batch processing, and iterative editing, all via simple natural language instructions.
